subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should ClawHub establish this versioned public plugin-evidence contract now, before the broader vetted-community trust model in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 is resolved?
rationale: The endpoint defines public security semantics that consumers may treat as authoritative, and code review cannot decide whether that permanent trust boundary is intended.

options.title: Approve a narrow evidence contract
options.body: Approve the endpoint only as non-endorsement evidence, require immutable selected-release provenance, separate current configuration, and fully type the schema before merge.

options.title: Defer to the trust RFC
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 decides the complete review vocabulary and ownership model.

options.title: Keep existing APIs only
options.body: Decline the aggregate endpoint and direct clients to existing package detail, security, readiness, and artifact surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow evidence contract
recommendation.body: Approve the endpoint only as non-endorsement evidence, require immutable selected-release provenance, separate current configuration, and fully type the schema before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has already offered the contributor a review and has recent adjacent ownership of the package HTTP API surface.
